notablePrerequisites: Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any land an opponent controls.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
